{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent 7-day true outcomes show upward momentum (e.g., >+2% daily avg) to avoid overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >+15% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 10-15% unless sentiment is strongly bullish.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if sentiment is neutral or slightly bullish (0.00–0.25) to align with delayed market reaction.",
    "If true outcome spikes >+10% from prior 30-day avg, reduce forecast by 10-20% to avoid overestimating volatility.",
    "When sentiment is positive (≥0.25), allow forecast to rise but cap at +10% above prior 30-day avg to prevent overcorrection.",
    "If model consistently underpredicts true outcomes in high-sentiment periods, add 5-10% bias to forecast to compensate for sentiment-driven momentum."
  ]
}
